definitions.explanation: A thin sushi roll filled with cucumber, wrapped in nori and rice. One of the simplest and most familiar sushi roll varieties.

examples.japanese: かっぱ{巻|ま}きを{一|ひと}つ{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
かっぱ{巻|ま}きはさっぱりしていて{食|た}べやすい。
examples.english: Cucumber rolls are refreshing and easy to eat.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}でも{食|た}べられるように、{回転寿司|かいてんずし}ではかっぱ{巻|ま}きが{定番|ていばん}だ。
examples.english: So that children can eat them too, cucumber rolls are a standard item at conveyor-belt sushi restaurants.

notes:
Named after {河童|かっぱ}, the legendary water creature said to love cucumbers. かっぱ{巻|ま}き is one of the most basic and inexpensive items on a sushi menu.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- かっぱ{巻|ま}きを{注文|ちゅうもん}する: to order a cucumber roll
- かっぱ{巻|ま}き{一|いち}{本|ぽん}: one cucumber roll

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鉄火巻|てっかま}き: tuna roll — similarly thin roll, filled with raw tuna instead of cucumber
- {細巻|ほそま}き: thin sushi roll — the general category that かっぱ{巻|ま}き and {鉄火巻|てっかま}き belong to
